snippet.title: Final Orbit - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4319800/Final_Orbit?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=launch&utm_content=trailer

Master the cockpit of highly realistic spacecraft in this Newtonian physics based sim. 
Take off from surface to space, plot a course between the planets and dock with space stations. 
Trade commodities or take shipping contracts to buy upgrades and optimize your build - every choice matters.

Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/HHPbbk4Mmm
